collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager wakes early enough to watch the first light reach the beach.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) wakes early enough to watch the first light reach the beach. The sand turns from gray to gold in a few quiet breaths.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) wakes early enough to watch the first light reach the beach. A seabird calls, and the whole morning seems to begin at once.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) wakes early enough to watch the first light reach the beach. Nobody else is on the beach yet, and (name1) enjoys the quiet.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) wakes early enough to watch the first light reach the beach. (name1) decides to wake this early again, and then probably will not.
